project_metadata.project_name: SmartHR - Single-File In-Browser HRMS & Timekeeping System
project_metadata.architecture: Single-File In-Browser Backend (React + TypeScript + Web Worker + Dexie.js + ONNX Runtime Web Hybrid CDN)
project_metadata.current_phase: Phase 10: Dexie Schema v5 — shiftClasses + rbacRoles chuyên nghiệp (user confirmed 1.ok 2.ok), 69 tests green

agent_profile.role: Senior Principal System Designer & Staff IT Software Engineer
rules: Evidence-First: Zero code fabrication without ground truth
No decision on ambiguous data; clarify with user before coding
Zero Native Browser Dialogs (Custom UI Toast/Modal Only)

source_files.chot_cong_template: /workspaces/HR-System/KIỂM TRA CHÔT CÔNG THÁNG 08.2026.xlsx (Sheets: Working time, Overtime, OT1, Thai san, Leave, Sheet1)
source_files.ui_kit_figma: /workspaces/HR-System/SmartHR - Free Figma UI Kit for HRM & Employee Management (Community).fig

user_confirmed_rules.overtime_rounding: Exact calculation without rounding blocks (e.g. 23 mins = 23/60 = 0.38h, exact standard overtime)
user_confirmed_rules.annual_leave_quota: Fully flexible: configurable upon creation and editable by HR Manager role
user_confirmed_rules.diligence_reduction_rules: Default applies company-wide, but fully customizable per department or employee class module

stores.employees: employeeId PK, erpId, fullName, department, shiftClassId FK→shiftClasses.shiftClassId, contractType, status, [department+status], [contractType+status], [shiftClassId+status], [department+contractType]
stores.rawAttendanceLogs: ++id PK auto-increment, employeeId FK, date, [employeeId+date], departmentCode, [departmentCode+date]
stores.dailyTimesheets: employeeId_date PK composite, employeeId FK, date, statusCode, isViolation, month, year, [month+year], [employeeId+month+year], [statusCode+month+year], [isViolation+month+year]
stores.overtimeRecords: employeeId_date PK composite, employeeId FK, date, verificationStatus, month, year, [month+year], [employeeId+month+year], [verificationStatus+month+year]
stores.leaveRequests: id PK string, employeeId FK, date, leaveType, status, department, [status+date], [employeeId+status], [department+status]
stores.shiftRosters: employeeId_date PK composite, employeeId FK, date, shiftCode FK→shiftClasses.shiftClassId, isRestViolation, department, [isRestViolation+date], [department+date]
stores.ocrScans: id PK, extractedEmployeeId, extractedDate, matchStatus, scanTimestamp, [matchStatus+scanTimestamp]
stores.shiftClasses: shiftClassId PK, startTime, endTime, standardWorkDays, isRotating, workDaysPattern — 4 ca mặc định OFFICE_M_F/M_S/SHIFT_1/2, cho phép custom SHIFT_3+
stores.rbacRoles: roleId PK, roleName, *permissions multiEntry, isSystem — 6 roles built-in từ DEFAULT_SETTINGS.rolePermissions, cho phép custom role

persistent_storage.helper: ensurePersistentStorage() in src/db/index.ts + call in src/main.tsx bootstrap, fallback warning via Toast if denied

verified_schemas.naming_convention_note: SKILL quy ước snake_case nhưng giữ camelCase store names để không mất IndexedDB người dùng cũ (đã ship v2/v3). Field camelCase, date YYYY-MM-DD cho index. shiftClasses/rbacRoles mới cũng dùng camelCase cho nhất quán.
